content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a HarborMesh production launch in 2028 or identify anyone who joined us for it.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"identification"},{"text":"On 2026-04-16, our code body recorded that we had authored HarborMesh's sensor scheduler.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We were then prototyping the replay adapter agreed with Mara, awaiting an outage field trial.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"A human field-trial report received 2026-05-03 through our code body described the April 30 trial.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The reporter said Mara's replay proposal became the prototype the reporter and their collaborators tested together.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"According to that report, the April 30 HarborMesh trial replayed buffered readings correctly through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift was understood.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the report received 2026-05-03, there was no production deployment yet; that does not establish the project's status in 2028.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Our 2026-04-16 project report named docs/STATUS.md at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh as the entry point for checking current state.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"My current voice body has no source network or repository runtime access to check later project status.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
